name: dust
description: Intuitive disk usage analyzer with colorized tree visualization

dust.description: Modern du replacement with colorized output and intelligent sorting
dust.usage:
dust -d 2 /c/Projects # Show 2 levels deep in Projects directory
dust -r -n 10 . # Reverse sort showing 10 smallest items
dust -x -s # Stay on filesystem, show size summary only
dust -b -t # Show sizes in bytes with file type icons
dust --no-colors -p # Plain output with full paths for scripting
